hints.title: Think in boundaries
hints.body: Rather than tracking headings and turning at corners, can you describe the unvisited part of the grid with four moving edges?

hints.title: Four shrinking sides
hints.body: Keep `top`, `bottom`, `left`, and `right`. Visit the top row, then the right column, then the bottom row, then the left column, shrinking the corresponding boundary after each step.

hints.title: Guard the short cases
hints.body: After the top and bottom rows, only continue down the right column if `top <= bottom`. After left and right, only continue up the left column if `left <= right`. These guards prevent duplicate visits when a row or column is already exhausted.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
top = 0, bottom = rows - 1
left = 0, right = columns - 1
result = []
while top <= bottom and left <= right:
    for column from left to right: add grid[top][column]
    top += 1
    for row from top to bottom: add grid[row][right]
    right -= 1
    if top <= bottom:
        for column from right down to left: add grid[bottom][column]
        bottom -= 1
    if left <= right:
        for row from bottom down to top: add grid[row][left]
        left += 1
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Return early for an empty grid.
